llm.answer:
**Core Graphics – Apple Developer Documentation (PDF)** *(All information is drawn from the three provided pages of the same PDF)* | Topic | Key Points | Source | |-------|------------|--------| | **Framework Overview** | • Built on the Quartz 2‑D drawing engine.
• Provides low‑level, lightweight 2‑D rendering with high‑fidelity output.
• Handles path‑based drawing, transformations, color management, off‑screen rendering, patterns, gradients, shading, image data management, image creation, image masking, PDF document creation, display, and parsing.
• On macOS, it also includes services for display‑hardware control, low‑level user‑input events, and the windowing system. | [Source 1] | | **Core Data Types** | • `CGFloat` – basic floating‑point scalar.
• `CGPoint`, `CGSize`, `CGRect` – geometric primitives.
• `CGVector`, `CGAffineTransform` – vector and transform utilities. | [Source 1] | | **Primary Classes** | • `CGContext` – Quartz 2‑D drawing environment.
• `CGImage`, `CGImageMask` – bitmap image handling.
• `CGPath`, `CGMutablePath` – immutable/ mutable graphic paths.
• `CGLayer` – off‑screen context for reusable content.
• `CGColor`, `CGColorSpace`, `CGColorConversionInfo` – color components and spaces.
• `CGFont` – glyph and layout information for text.
• `CGPDFDocument` – PDF document representation.
• `CGDataConsumer`, `CGDataProvider` – abstractions for raw data I/O.
• `CGShading`, `CGGradient` – smooth color transitions for radial/axial fills.
• `CGFunction` – callback‑based function definition.
• `CGPattern` – 2‑D pattern for drawing paths. | [Source 1] | | **Quartz Services** | • **QuartzDisplayServices** – direct access to macOS window server for configuring/display hardware.
• **QuartzEventServices** – manage event taps (filters) for observing/altering low‑level user‑input streams.
• **QuartzWindowServices** – provides information about windows managed by the macOS window server. | [Source 3] | | **Enumerations, Constants & Functions** | • The framework defines a rich set of enumerations, constants, and functions for fine‑grained control of rendering, color spaces, image formats, and PDF handling. | [Source 2] | | **Platform Availability** | • iOS 2.0+, iPadOS 2.0+, Mac Catalyst 13.1+, macOS 10.8+, tvOS 9.0+, visionOS 1.0+, watchOS 2.0+. | [Source 1] | ### Take‑away Summary Core Graphics is a low‑level, high‑performance 2‑D rendering engine that sits atop Quartz. It gives developers fine‑grained control over drawing primitives, transformations, color spaces, and image handling, while also exposing services for display hardware, event handling, and window management on macOS. The framework’s rich set of data types, classes, and services makes it the foundation for custom graphics, PDF manipulation, and advanced UI rendering across all Apple platforms.
